## Summary

Explain what changed and why.

## Source and attribution

For catalog changes, link the canonical GitHub source and describe any licensing or attribution considerations.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `npm test`.
- [ ] I previewed the site at desktop and mobile widths.
- [ ] Descriptions are factual and written in original language.
- [ ] New links use canonical `https://github.com/...` URLs.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private data, or copied third-party content.
